description: Implementation of the DeviceRegistry class managing device registration, unregistration, and retrieval in the WebRTC operator component of the Android Open Source Project.

classes.name: DeviceRegistry
classes.description: Class responsible for managing device registration, unregistration, and lookup.

methods.name: RegisterDevice
methods.description: Registers a device with a given device ID and device handler.

methods.name: UnRegisterDevice
methods.description: Unregisters a device by its device ID.

methods.name: GetDevice
methods.description: Retrieves a shared pointer to the device handler for a given device ID.

methods.name: ListDeviceIds
methods.description: Returns a list of all registered device IDs.
